t: A beautiful idea: how COVAX has fallen short - The Lancet
s: June 19, 2021 - Writing in a blog post earlier this year, Andrea Taylor, who manages the Launch and Scale Speedometer vaccine tracker, has said that “COVAX was premised on an all-for-one-and-one-for-all approach to defeating the pandemic”, adding that “this would have led to the best outcomes for everyone and was our best hope for ending the pandemic quickly.
